edges.description: Myopia is consistently reported in this disorder and in the type II collagenopathies generally, but no study cited here traces the refractive error to a measured vitreous or scleral collagen abnormality in these patients, so the step is recorded as indirect.

nodes.description: A structurally defective type II collagen network in hyaline cartilage. The consequences track the tissues in which type II collagen is the dominant structural protein: the growth plates of the long bones, the cartilaginous vertebral bodies and pelvis, and the vitreous humor.
